name: Metric Space Disguise
description: Replaced the explicit exclusion of shared structural components (which clearly signals Exact Cover / 3-Dimensional Matching) with a requirement that the Hamming distance between every pair of selected vectors is exactly 3. Because there are $k$ vectors of length 3 over an alphabet of size $k$, this mathematically forces a perfect matching in each coordinate. Models that blindly translate the text will write a generic max-clique or naive backtracking search and TLE; models that reason about the mathematical structure will deduce the permutation requirement and use efficient Exact Cover algorithms.
